tei:titleStmt.tei:title: ༄༅/ /dbyangs can ma dkar dmar zung gi sbyin sreg sgrub thabs dang bcas pa blo gros pad tshal rgyas byed nyi ma zhes bya ba bzhugs/
༄༅/ /dbyangs can ma dkar dmar zung gi sbyin sreg sgrub thabs dang bcas pa blo gros pad tshal rgyas byed nyi ma zhes bya ba bzhugs/

tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /dbyangs can ma dkar dmar zung gi sbyin sreg sgrub thabs

dang bcas pa blo gros pad tshal rgyas byed nyi ma zhes bya ba bzhugs/ na mo swa ra swa st+yai/ 'jig rten mes po'i tshems dkar pad tshal las/ /legs 'khrungs tshangs sras dbyangs can ngang mo nyid/ /sgra dbyangs rgya mtsho'i rgyud mang sgrogs bzhin par/ /tshur byon bdag blo'i chu gter dpal bskyed mdzod/ /de la 'dir dbyangs can ma dkar dmar gnyis kyi bsnyen sgrub dang 'brel ba'i sbyin sreg ji ltar bya ba'i rim pa mdor bsdus pa zhig brjod par bya ste/ rnam dpyod don du gnyer ba dag gis lha mo 'di gnyis gang rung gi bsnyen pa sngon du btang nas sby-in sreg bya ba la/ rdzas dang yo byad nyer mkho rnams sta gon byas nas/ sbyin sreg bya ba'i gzhi'i sa sngar longs spyad pa yin na/ sa chog dgos pa'i nges pa med kyang de min gzhan nas 'byung ba ltar sa chog byed pa'am/ de tsam ma grub na rang nyid lha'i nga rgyal dang ldan pas/ auṃ ha na ha na badzra kro dha hūṃ phaṭa/ rang gi thugs ka nas spros pa'i rdo rje khro bos bgegs rnams bcom zhing*/ auṃ āḥhūṃ/ rdo rje gsum gyis sa'i nyes skyon thams cad sbyangs par gyur/ 'dod na auṃ badzra a mṛ ta nas ha na hūṃ phaṭa/ lan gsum sogs brjod de thal ba yungs dkar dri chu sogs kyis sbyang bar bya ste/ kun rdzob kyi dag pa dang*/ sa'i nyes skyon thams cad rang bzhin gyis stong pa'i bdag nyid du gyur ces brjod cing bsam pa ni don dam pa'i sbyang ba'o/ /sa gzhi rang bzhin gyis dkar ba'am/ dkar po gzhan gyis byugs la dbus btsal nas tshangs zur gyi thig dang*/ de nas dbus nas khru phyed kyis zlum bskor dang*/ de la sor bzhi bsnan nas zlum por bskor bar bya'o/ /kha khyer logs su bskor na sor bzhi bsnan cing*/ dbus nas sor bzhis zlum bskor dang*/ thabs kyi dpangs su sor bcu gnyis dang*/ steng du kha khyer sor bzhi pa gud du btags na ni legs/ kha khyer la rdo rje dang rin po che'i 'phreng bas bskor zhing*/

zlum thig phyi ma'i phyogs bzhi nas sor gnyis re dor te gru bzhir gdab/ phyi'i grwa bzhir zla phyed rdo rje dang*/ thab kyi dbus su padma dkar po dang dmar po'am/ sna tshogs padma'i lte bar dbyangs can ma dkar mo la pi waṃ ngam/ de la hrīṃ dkar pos mtshan pa'am hrīṃ tsam dgod cing*/ dmar mo la me long nor bu hrīṃ yig gis mtshan pa'am hrīṃ dgod/ slob dpon dang thab kyi bar du me yol la baṃ 'dri ba dang*/ rlung g.yab sngon po la rlung dkyil dang yaṃ 'bri bar 'dod na bya la/ spyir 'gre la ma byas kyang rung*/ gzhan 'das ma 'das kyi gtor ma dang mchod pa rnams dang*/ so rtsi/ gos zung rnams phyag len ltar bshams/ gzhi bdag gtor ma dang*/ cha gsum byed par 'dod na rung zhing ma byas kyang chad lhag tu mi 'gyur/ yam shing 'om bu sogs 'o ma can gyi shing*/ mar khu la ni byung na mar dkar bzhus pa dang*/ ma grub na 'bru mar yang rung*/ rdzas la bsnyen pa'i kha skong ba'i skabs su til nges par dgos 'dug kyang ma rnyed na de dang zar ma bsres nas 'bul ba'i phyag len ltar yang rung tsam/ 'dir rdzas chen bcu gnyis po thams cad 'bul rgyu byung na legs med na )nges par dgos pa min pas thams cad dam/ ci 'grub kyis kyang rung la/ yam shing dang mar khu gnyis ni med du mi rung ba'o/ /thab kyi nang gi ri mo sho ras kyis bkab ste bud shing bzang po zlum por brtsigs/ amṛ ta brgya sogs bzlas pa'i bsang chu sta gon bya zhing*/ chas byed dam ma byas kyang chog stan ji ltar 'tshams pa'i steng du padma'i 'dug stangs kyis kha shar du phyogs te smra ba gzhan bcad nas/ dkyil 'khor chen mo rnams kyi sbyin sreg byed pa'i thog mar rdor dril byin brlab bya tshul bshad kyang*/ lha re re tsam gyi sbyin sreg gi thog mar rdor dril byin brlab bya ba'i tshul mi gsal bar mchod pa byin brlabs nas 'jug par bshad pa mang zhing*/

khyad par du 'di'i sbyin sreg gi cho gar yang rdor dril byin brlab bya bar ma bshad pa ltar rung bar snang yang*/ rdor dril byin brlab byas kyang mi 'gal bas spyi ltar byed pa'am/ /bsdu na/ rdo rje ni thabs dang*/ dril bu ni shes rab ste/ de gnyis ka'ang don dam pa'i byang chub kyi sems kyi rang bzhin no/ /zhes pa tsam gyis dag pa dran par bya'o/ /de nas a mṛ ta brjod cing bsang chu nas blangs te thabs dang mchod rdzas sogs la rang gi g.yon nas brtsams te g.yas skor du bsang gtor lan gsum bya'o/ /slar yang mchod pa bsang chus bsangs/ auṃ swa bhā was stong par sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las auṃ las rin po che'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba rnams kyi nang du auṃ 'od du zhu ba las byung ba'i mchod yod nas rol mo rnams dwangs shing thogs pa med pa zag pa med pa'i bde ba khyad par can bskyed par gyur par bsams la/ so so'i phyag rgya dang bcas te auṃ arghaṃ āḥhūṃ nas shapta āḥhūṃ gi bar gyis byin gyis brlabs shing*/ sngags drug dang phyag rgya drug gis kyang byin brlab bya bar bshad/ skabs 'dir chu bzhi byin brlabs bya bar 'dod na rung bar sems kyang*/ 'di'i sbyin sreg gi cho gar chu gnyis tsam 'bul bar bshad pa ltar byas kyang rung bas gang rung gi chog /de nas rdo rje'i khu tshur las gung mo gnyis rtse sprad de/ rdzas rnams bkrus par bsams la/ auṃ swāhā zhes brjod/ auṃ ā swāhās yam shing dang*/ auṃ shrīḥswāhās mar khu/ auṃ dzriṃ swāhās 'bru/ auṃ ku ru ku ru swāhās/ de dag las gzhan pa'i rdzas rnams kyi mtshan nyid dang mi ldan pa'i nyes skyon thams cad sbyangs nas bdud rtsi lnga'i ngo bor gyur par bsams/ de nas me gang yang rung ba la/ auṃ āḥhūṃ lan gsum gyis me sbar te/ de la 'khyil ba lan gsum brjod cing sngar ltar lan gsum bsangs nas thab du 'jug pa dang mnyam du/

hrīṃḥ.a ā nas aṃ aḥ'i bar lan gsum dang*/ auṃ badzra dzwa la raṃ/ zhes brjod de sbor zhing gzi byin bskyed/ dmar mo la dbyangs ma brjod kyang chog /de nas hūṃ bdun brjod cig rlung g.yab kyis me sbar/ slar yang auṃ badzra dzwa la raṃ/ zhes brjod cing blugs gzar bdun gyis me gsau/ de nas ku sha rnams lag tu bzung nas/ auṃ badzra satwa hūṃ/ lan bdun gyis byin gyis brlabs la/ auṃ ku sha 'di ni gtsang zhing dge /tshangs pa lha rnams dag byed yin/ /dkon mchog gsum po mnyes byed pa/ /sa las skyes pa'i 'dab ma'i snying*/ /bdag gi bgegs rnams thams cad ni/ /zhi dang bkra shis mdzad du gsol/ /zhes pa lan gsum brjod pa'i mthar/ ku sha ring bzung re rtse mo rang gi g.yon nas brtsams te thab kyi shar dang lho dang nub dang byang gi kha khyer la snga mas rtse mos phyi ma'i rtsa ba gnod par dgram zhing*/ thab khung du ku sha rtse mo shar du bstan pas g.yog go /ku sha dgos zin pa dang thal mo sbyar te/ bcom ldan 'das rdo rje sems dpa' bgegs thams cad zhi ba dang bkra shis par mdzad du gsol/ zhes gsol ba gdab/ de nas las sngags brjod cing bsang chus thab bsangs/ auṃ swa bhā wa nas shuddhonya haṃ/ thab stong pa nyid du gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las paṃ las sna tshogs padma dang a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hūṃ las rdo rje dkar po/ de yongs su gyur pa las ye shes kyi thab kha dog dkar zhing dbyibs zlum pa/ rgyar khru gang dang zabs su khru phyed pa/ mu ran kha khyer dang bcas pa kha khyer la rdo rje dang rin po che'i phreng bas bskor ba/ phyi'i grwa bzhir zla phyed rdo rje mtshan pa/ dwangs shing thogs pa med pa gyur/ thab kyi nang du raṃ las skyes pa'i me gru gsum pa'i dbus su/ sna tshogs padma'i lte bar raṃ las bgrang phreng*/ de yongs su gyur pa las me lha sku mdog dmar po 'od zer dkar po 'phro ba/

zhi zhing 'dzum pa'i nyams can/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ g.yas bgrang 'phreng dang*/ g.yon spyi blugs bsnams pa/ gsus khyim che zhing sma ra dang ag tshom dang ral ba'i thor cog rnams dkar ba/ dar gyi ang rag gsol zhing srad bu dkar po'i se ral can/ zhabs sems dpa'i skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa'i dpral bar auṃ dkar po/ mgrin par āḥdamar po/ thugs kar hūṃ sngon pos mtshan par gyur/ rang dang dam tshig pa'i thugs ka'i hūṃ las 'od zer lcags kyu lta bu 'phros pas/ shar lho nas 'dzin byed mi lha'i rgyal po drang srong gi tshogs dang bcas pa spyan drangs/ lag pa g.yas mi 'jigs pa'i phyag rgyas mthe bong g.yab cing*/ auṃ tshur spyon tshur spyon 'byung po che/ /me lha'i rgyal po drang srong mchog /sreg blug zhal zas bzhes slad du/ /'di ni yang dag bsnyen par mdzod/ /ces lan gsum dang*/ de'i mjug tu spyan 'dren gyi sngags ring dang tshig bcad gnyis gzhung kha cig tu 'byung yang*/ phal cher las mi 'byung bas bzhag ste/ auṃ agna ye ma hā ka ru ṇi ka e hye hi/ hūṃ mdzad kyi phyag rgya byas te/ ṭakki hūṃ dzaḥthab kyi me mtshams kyi kha khyer gyi ku sha'i gdan la bzhugs par gyur/ padma ka ma la ye st+raṃ/ a mṛ tas phyir 'brang gi bgegs bskrad/ oṃ āḥhrīḥpra wa ra sad ka raṃ arghaṃ pra tītstsha hūṃ swāhā/ zhes pas mchod yon dang*/ auṃ āḥhrīḥ nas pā dyaṃ pra tītstsha hūṃ swāhās zhabs bsil dbul/ yang na auṃ badzra agna ye arghaṃ pra tītstsha dang*/ de bzhin du pā dyaṃ pra tītstsha hūṃ swāhās zhabs bsil te chu gnyis dbul zhing*/ 'dod na chu bzhi yang 'bul rung bar sems so/ /de nas auṃ badzra aṃ ku sha dzaḥ auṃ badzra pā sha hūṃ/ auṃ badzra spho ṭa baṃ/ auṃ badzra ghaṇḍa hoḥs gzhug sogs bya/ 'dir dbang bskur rgyas 'debs mdzad pa'i lugs 'dug kyang*/ gzhung gzhan phal cher nas de mi 'byung ba ltar chog pas bzhag ste/

slar yang chu gnyis tsam mam/ chu bzhi phul rjes/ auṃ badzra agna ye puṣpe pra tītstsha hūṃ swāhā/ nas apta pra tītstsha'i bar gyis mchod cing*/ yang na sngags ring la mchod sngags sbyar nas phul chog cing*/ nang mchod mi dgos/ bstod pa ni skabs 'dir 'brel bas/ 'jig rten dbang phyug tshangs dbang mgon gyi sras/ /me lha'i rgyal po ṭakkis dbang bskur ba/ /shes rab mchog gis nyon mongs thams cad bsreg /'dzin byed me lha nyid la rnam par 'dud/ /ces sam/ me ste bsreg bya za ba'i lha/ /zhes sogs kyis bstod cing*/ yang na bstod pa rgyas pa spyi ltar bya'o/ /de nas me lha'i dam tshig gi phyag rgya byas te/ auṃ badzra a na la ma hā bhū ta dzwa la dzwa la ya/ sarba bha smi ku ru/ sarba duṣtaṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ tṛ shye dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ sa ma ya st+waṃ/ sa ma ya haṃ/ zhes pa lan gsum gyis dam tshig bsgrags/ de nas dgang blugs bzung ste me lha'i ljags rdo rje'i rnam pa can dkar po la raṃ yig dang*/ dgang blugs kyi kha la yaṃ )yig 'od zer 'bar ba dang bcas pas mtshan par gyur par bsams la/ auṃ badzra agna ye zhes pa'am/ auṃ agna ye nas ba ha nā ye swāhā/ zhes pa bdun gyis mar khu 'bul zhing*/ phyi ma la nā ya dang swāhā'i bar du spel tshig gang 'dod pa de sbyor zhing*/ de yang bdag gi rnam dpyod rgyas pa la bar du gcod pa'i sdig sgrib dang*/ lhag chad kyi nyes pa thams cad shantiṅku ru ye swāhā/ zhes pa lta bu'o/ /de nas rdzas chen bcu gnyis sam/ gang 'byor 'bul ba'i thog mar/ yam shing bzung nas/ yam shing rnams byang chub kyi shing gi rang bzhin du gyur/ ces brjod cing bsams/ auṃ agna ye nas ba ha nā ye/ auṃ bo dhi bṛkṣa ye/ bdag gi rnam dpyod nas/ nyes pa thams cad dang gzi brjid rgyas pa la bar du gcod pa thams cad shantiṅku ru ye swāhā/ bsdus pa la gong gi sngags thung dang rdzas sngags rnams sbyar bar bshad pa ltar yang rung*/

de bzhin du mar khu me lha'i sngags kyi mthar/ auṃ agna ye= bdag gi= 'byor rgyas pa la= til la/ de bzhin du/ auṃ sarba pa bāṃ da ha na badzra ye/ sdig pa thams cad shantiṅku ru= dur ba la/ auṃ badzra ā yu ṣe/ tshe rgyas pa la= 'bras la/ auṃ badzra puṣta ye/ bsod nams rgyas pa la= zho zan la/ auṃ sarba saṃ bā de/ bde ba mchog la bar du gcod pa= ku sha la/ auṃ a pra ti ha ta badzra ye/ bsrung ba mchog la bar du= yungs kar la/ auṃ sarba artha siddha ye/ bgegs thams cad= so ba la/ auṃ badzra bi dza ye/ nor dang 'bru rgyas pa la= nas la/ auṃ ma hā be ga ye/ myur ba'i shugs phun sum tshogs pa la= sran ma la/ auṃ ma hā ba la ye/ stobs rgyas pa la= gro la/ auṃ badzra ghasma ri/ bdag gi= nad thams cad shantiṅku ru ye swāhā zhes sbyor/ skabs 'dir shes rab rgyas pa'i ched du bsnyen pa byed pa dang*/ de'i lhag chad gyi nyes pa sbyong ba'i ched du sbyin sreg byed pa dgos pa'i gtso bo yin pas/ til nges par dgos par sems so/ /ka ra bu ram sbrang rtsi ste mngar gsum la sngags kyi mjug tu/ auṃ badzra ma le pust+ra ya zhes dang spel tshig bcas sbyor/ de nas badzra agna ye arghaṃ nas shapta pra tītstsha'i bar mchod de bstod pa'am/ min yang rung ste/ slar yang snga ma ltar mchod yon dang zhabs bsil gnyis sam/ zhal bsil dang bsang gtor 'bul yang rung bar sems so/ /'dir mar khu lan bdun phul nas/ auṃ badzra dzwa la raṃ/ me lha me 'bar ba'i rnam pa can du gyur ces brjod cing bsam/ /༈ de nas 'das pa'i me lha bskyed cig mchod pa la/ dbyangs can ma dkar dmar gang yin kyang sbyin sreg gi me 'bar ba'i dbus bu bskyed dgos shing*/ de yang thab kyi nang du ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus su/ dkar mo yin na baṃ las padma dkar po dang*/ dmar mo la/ baṃ las padma dmar po 'dab ma brgyad pa'i lte bar a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor zhes sogs so so'i bsgrub thabs nas 'byung ba ltar bskyed de/

thugs ka hūṃ sngon po zhes pa'i mjug tu/ sgrub thabs su bkod pa ltar thugs ka'i sa bon gyi 'od zer gyis ye shes pa spyan drangs nas bstim/ 'on kyang dkar mo'i sbyin sreg gi skabs su ye shes pa spyan 'dren pa'i tshul sgrub thabs kho na ltar byed mi dgos pa ni logs su bshad pa ltar ro/ /de nas mchod 'bul ni/ rab 'byams rgya mtsho dpag med na/ /mchod yon ji snyed yod pa dang*/ /bdag gis 'bul ba'i mchod yon 'di/ /bzhes nas rnam dpyod dngos grub stsol/ /auṃ sa ra swa sti sa pā ri wā ra arghaṃ pra tītstsha hūṃ swāhā zhes pa dang*/ de bzhin du shapta'i bar sbyar la mchod/ de nas dril stabs dang bcas te/ yid 'phrog mdzes sdug rnam 'gyur cir yang ston/ /sgra dbyangs rgya mtsho'i snyan pa 'bum phrag sgrogs/ /zab yangs mkhyen brtse nyi zla ltar gsal ba/ /tshangs sras lha mo'i sku gsung thugs la bstod/ /padma'i bzhin la g.yo ldan bung ba'i spyan/ /mthon mthing ral ba phyed bcings thor tshugs can/ /rol sgeg gar gyis 'gyings pa'i dbyangs can ma/ /bdag la rnam dpyod spobs pa'i mchog stsol mdzod/ /bstod gsol 'di dbyangs can ma gnyis ka la sbyar chog /de nas lha mo'i ljags rdo rje'i rnam pa can dkar po la raṃ gyis mtshan par gyur/ auṃ swa ra swa sti hrīṃ a ā nas aṃ aḥzhes pas mar khu phul nas spel tshig sbyor/ de nas yam shing rnams byang chub kyi shing gi rang bzhin can du gyur par bsams la/ auṃ swa ra swa st+yai hrīṃḥ a ā nas aṃ aḥ auṃ bo dhi bṛkṣa ye swāhā zhes sogs sngar bzhin rdzas sngags spel tshig dang bcas pa sbyor/ thams cad la ma grub na thog mtha' gnyis tsam la sbyar yang rung*/ grangs ni spy-ir gsum/ bdun/ nyer gcig sogs mtha' gcig tu ma nges kyang*/ yam shing dang mar khu til gsum grangs mang ba dang*/ khyad par du lhag chad gyi nyes pa sbyong ched til grangs mang du 'bul zhing*/

mngar gsum dang me tog dmar po yang mang tsam 'bul ba legs/ de nas dgang blugs bdun phul nas/ chu gnyis nyer spyaud rol mo rnams kyis mchod cing bstod la/ spyir 'das pa'i me lha la gtor ma dgos pa'i nges pa mi snang yang 'dir 'bul ba'i srol yod pa ltar na/ gtor ma dgang gzar du bzhag nas bsangs sbyang te/ stong pa'i ngang las auṃ las rin po che'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du oṃ 'od du zhu ba las byung ba'i gtor ma ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur par bsams la/ a ka ro'i mthar yi ge gsum btags pa lan gsum gyis byin gyis brlabs la/ auṃ swa ra swa st+yai hrīṃḥ a ā nas aṃ aḥ auṃ a ka ro sogs lan bdun nam gsum gyi mthar thab tu phul/ dmar mo la dbyangs yig ma brjod kyang rung*/ de nas auṃ badzra taṃ bu la ye swāhās so rtsi dang*/ auṃ badzra wast+ra ye swāhās gos zung dbul/ auṃ swa ra swa sti arghaṃ nas shapta'i bar gyis mchod la bstod cing*/ yig brgya bzlas nas thal mo sbyar te/ gang yang bdag blo rmongs pa yis/ /zhes sogs dang*/ lhag pa dang ni nas de yang bzod par mdzad du gsol/ /auṃ khyed kyis sems can don kun mdzad/ /nas/ 'byon par mdzad du gsol/ /auṃ āḥbadzra muḥ ye shes pa rang bzhin gyi gnas su gshegs shing dam tshig pa rang nyid la thim par gyur/ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ slar yang 'jig rten pa'i me lha mchod pa ni/ oṃ badzra dzwa la raṃ/ zhes pa lan gsum gyis mar khu phul te/ slar yang ye shes kyi me 'bar ba las me lha'i skur bzhengs par gyur ces brjod de/ rdzas lhag rnams sngar ltar sngags ring thung gang rung gis phul rjes/ so rtsi dang gos zung kyang phul/ gtor ma sngar ltar bsangs sbyangs bskyed de/ a ka ro lan gsum gyi byin gyis brlabs nas/ auṃ agna ye/ a ka ro sogs lan gsum mam bdun gyis sngar bzhin phul te/ me ste bsreg bya za ba'i lha/

/zhes sogs kyis bstod cing*/ mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di bsnoms la/ /zhes pa nas yid la 'dod pa kun 'grub shog /ces pa'i bar gyis 'phrin las bcol/ yig brgya bzlas nas/ ma rnyed ces sogs kyis bzod gsol dang*/ rang gi don dang gzhan gyi don/ /sgrub byed bsreg bya za ba gshegs/ /ji bzhin dus su tshur byon nas/ /bdag gi dngos grub thams cad sgrubs/ /auṃ agna ye badzra muḥ me lha ye shes pa rang bzhin gyi gnas su gshegs/ dam tshig pa me 'bar ba'i rnam pa can du gyur ces brjod cing bsngo smon shis brjod bya/ de nas gzhi bdag gtor ma dang cha gsum btang kyang legs/ slar 'bul ba'i skabs thab kyi nang gi bud shing 'bar 'phro che ba rnams dor nas thal ba mnan te/ steng du shing gsar pa brtsigs nas sngar ltar 'bul ba yin la/ de'i tshe thab myur du mi 'jig pa'i ched du nang ngos su 'jim pa legs por byugs na khyad che'o/ /sarba maṅga laṃ// //
mes po'i shul bzhag las/ co ne grags pa bshad sgrub kyi gsung 'bum/dbyangs can ma dkar dmar zung gi sbyin sreg sgrub thabs dang bcas pa bzhugs/ -PAGE 116--PAGE 117--PAGE 107-
